name: ETH 跟随 BTC 大盘状态
author: MayStock examples
notes: 跨标的示例：只在 BTC 处于自身上升趋势时才交易 ETH。ETH 的 beta 高于 BTC，大盘转弱时单独看 ETH 的信号极易假突破。btc 变量来自 data 块声明的另一标的收盘价，按 K 线时间轴对齐。

signals.longEntry: ema(close, fast) crosses_above ema(close, slow) and btc > sma(btc, btcTrend)
signals.longExit: ema(close, fast) crosses_below ema(close, slow) or btc < sma(btc, btcTrend)
